sn47.15:1.1: Sāvatthi nidanaṃ || || Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || [pe] || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yaṃ aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || Tasmā ti ha tvam Bāhiya ādim eva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu || || Ko cādi kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ || sīlañca suvisuddhaṃ diṭṭhi ca ujukā || || Yato ca kho te Bāhiya sīlañca suvisuddham bhavissati diṭṭhi ca ujukā || tato tvam Bāhiya sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi ||
sn47.15:2.1: katame cattāro || || Idha tvam Bāhiya kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Yato kho tvam Bāhiya sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evam bhāvessasi || tato {tuyham} Bāhiya yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissasi || vuddhi yeva paṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānī ti || ||
sn47.15:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo eko vupakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || Khīnā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam ittatthāyā ti abbhaññāsi || || Aññataro ca panāyasmā Bāhiyo arahatam ahosī ti
